committee: *Presentation Notice for Legislative Certificate No. 159-38 (COR) - Senator Sabrina Salas Matanane
title: Join me for the presentation of Legislative Certificate No. 159-38 (COR) to the Guam Green Growth (G3) GROW Corps, “for your contributions to developing the island’s green economy and workforce, and efforts in reforestation and the restoration of the Ugum Watershed; and to commend you for successfully completing the University of Guam’s (UOG) Guam Green Growth (G3) GROW Conservation Corps Program.” The presentation will take place during the G3 GROW Corps Graduation Ceremony on Wednesday, January 14, 2026, at 11:00AM at the Government House in Agana Heights.
